findings.claim: FICO 與原告於 2026-09-29 簽訂和解條款書：就 FICO Scores 反壟斷集體訴訟，支付 6,500 萬美元現金並附合規承諾，不承認不當行為；仍待法院最終核准
findings.excerpt: On September 29, 2026, FICO and the plaintiffs entered into a term sheet memorializing the material terms of a proposed settlement of the lawsuits. In consideration of a cash payment by FICO to the plaintiffs of $65.0 million and certain compliance undertakings, the settlement would fully resolve all remaining claims asserted against FICO in the lawsuits.

findings.claim: 2026-10-01 公司承諾裁員約 15% 職位，預計 FY2026 Q4 認列約 2,700 萬美元稅前費用
findings.excerpt: This plan involves the elimination of approximately 15% of positions across the Company.

findings.claim: 2026-06-05 增設 15 億美元無擔保定期貸款，所得用於加速股票回購（ASR）
findings.excerpt: The Company borrowed the full amount of the Incremental Term Loan on June 5, 2026, and will use these proceeds pursuant to the accelerated share repurchase program described in Item 8.01 below.

note: 搜尋未見 FDA／召回／SEC 調查或重編；有律所徵集與參議員 Hawley 2026-03-23 調查報導（政治調查，非 SEC）。
